title: Cover endpoint can serve a digest before it is completed
reasoning: get_digest_cover only checks that the digest row and target file exist, then returns the embedded image. It does not reject queued, processing, or failed digests, unlike the sibling download-by-id route. Digest rows are created with a deterministic EPUB filename while still processing, so if a previous file with that name already exists, this route can return a stale cover for a digest that has not completed yet; if the file is partially written or invalid, clients get inconsistent errors instead of the same 409 contract used for downloads.
recommendation: Add a completed-status guard to get_digest_cover before resolving the file path, returning 409 with a clear message when digest.status is not completed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing cover route test only creates a completed digest and asserts the happy path. The searched tests contain no /cover case for processing or failed digests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a digest with status='processing' and a valid EPUB file at its filename, then assert GET /api/digests/{id}/cover returns 409 and does not return image bytes.
minimumFixScope: app/api/digests.py status check plus one route-level regression test.
